card.name: Inside EMBRYO-FETAL in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter piece "O" in the capitalized word EMBRYO of the boxed-warning heading EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. Also seen rarely on other partway-through-word pieces, such as the end of WATERSHEDS.

modes.label: Embryo-fetal heading
modes.description: The "O" ending EMBRY in capitalized boxed-warning titles, just before -FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Occasional pieces inside long capitalized or technical words outside warnings.

card.plain: It fires on the spelling of EMBRYO in the all-caps boxed warning title EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.
